findings.text: the fragment cites PLAN_LANDING_CONTRACT as living in tests/test_crew_prompts.py, but the constant is defined at reckon/crew/prompts.py:152 and only imported at tests/test_crew_prompts.py:23, so the citation points a reader at the import rather than its home; carried from the prior review at 77a44905b and left unchanged by the repair.

both suite-arm logs open with a label ('# base arm', '# head arm') where the test_logs clause asks the first line to name the revision, tree and command, so review.recorded_log_revision returns None for both and the derived added-failure count carries no revision (logs/review-added-failures-derivation.log).

the after_suite block names revision 92409e9c0ffd686c80f39e81dd5a2fd36aee8f69 while the log it cites was run at 4c91e7bb6 with uncommitted edits (logs/arm_head_three_files.log:2) and predates the commit it is attributed to, so the record cannot tie the head-arm count to the reviewed head from its own citation; I re-ran that arm at 92409e9c and the result does hold (logs/review-head-three-files.log: 58 passed, EXIT=0).

the repaired assertion line is not ruff-format clean — ruff format --diff would wrap it in parentheses — adding a formatting deviation to a file that already carries a format backlog and two pre-existing lint findings (logs/review-ruff-head.log).

item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to bring the two prompt tests and the skills' landing sentence in line with the runtime prompt's fragment landing contract, and at 92409e9c the six ids red at the base pass, the prompt-derived sentence sits verbatim in skills/reckon-build/SKILL.md:787, references/worker-protocol.md:213 and references/sprint-orchestration.md:420 and :507, and the assertion pinned at tests/test_skill_contracts.py:749 carries that same sentence (logs/review-pinned-sentence.log; logs/review-head-three-files.log: 58 passed, EXIT=0).
item_verdicts.manifest: read at 9056 bytes; status complete, both commits listed, changed_paths including the companion file, one landing line, both suite arms as JSON carrying completed true with failure counts 6 and 0, the negative-control path and note, artifacts, evidence_inputs and follow_ons; its after_suite block names revision 92409e9c0 while the log it cites (logs/arm_head_three_files.log:2) records 4c91e7bb6 with '(worktree, uncommitted edits)', so that citation does not tie the head-arm count to the commit it claims.

justifications.durability: the repair is verified by reinstating the regression it guards — the pinned id fails at 77a44905b and passes at 92409e9c (logs/review-pre-repair-single-id.log, logs/review-head-single-id.log) — and the sentence it pins is the prompt's own text, whose locator the negative control shows raising ValueError when the prompt anchor is reworded (logs/negative_control_reworded_anchor.log).
justifications.evidence: the gate measures what the done-when asserts and I reproduced every arm at the reviewed revisions (logs/review-head-skill-contracts.log, logs/review-base-skill-contracts.log, logs/review-pre-repair-single-id.log, logs/review-head-single-id.log, logs/review-head-three-files.log), but the reviewed run's own arm logs open with a label so the derived count carries no revision (logs/review-added-failures-derivation.log: base_log_revision null, head_log_revision null), and its after_suite revision names 92409e9c0 where the cited log records 4c91e7bb6.
justifications.fit: the added constants and the repaired assertion follow the file idiom and ruff lint shows no delta at tests/test_skill_contracts.py (2 pre-existing findings at both revisions), but the repaired line at tests/test_skill_contracts.py:749 is not ruff-format clean in a file already carrying a format backlog (logs/review-ruff-head.log), and the fragment still cites the prompt constant to the wrong file (docs/evidence/fragments/the-suite-is-green-at-head/skill-landing-sentence-follows-the-prompt.html:23).
justifications.goal_fidelity: the landed change at 92409e9c does what the goal states — the three subject files read 58 passed EXIT=0 at the reviewed head (logs/review-head-three-files.log), the derived sentence is verbatim in all three skill files and in the pinned assertion (logs/review-pinned-sentence.log), and the prompt-test constants follow the prompt's own current anchors (tests/test_crew_prompts.py:216).
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in both commits is inside the declared write paths except tests/test_skill_contracts.py, which is the companion file the coordinator's resume advice explicitly authorised and the manifest names with that reason (resume-1-advice.txt, manifest.md changed_paths), and the reviewed worktree is clean at 92409e9c.
